-고 있다 vs -아/어 있다 구분하기

Learners will be able to explain the difference between -고 있다 and -아/어 있다 and correctly choose and form sentences (affirmative, negative, interrogative) that express either ongoing actions or resulting/stative conditions.

THE PATTERN
-고 있다
is/am/are ...-ing (action in progress)
Use it when an action is in progress right now. Attach -고 있다 to the verb stem, whether or not it ends in a final consonant (먹다 → 먹고 있다, 가다 → 가고 있다).엄마가 밥을 먹고 있어요.
Mom is eating (a meal).
-아/어 있다
is/are ... (in a resulting state after an action)
Use it when the result of a completed action continues as a state now. It is used with intransitive or passive verbs, not transitive ones: use -아 있다 after ㅏ/ㅗ stems and -어 있다 after other stems (열리다 → 열려 있다, 앉다 → 앉아 있다).창문이 열려 있어요.
The window is open (it has been opened and stays open).
